summary_en: CSP introduced DOE (dividend on equity) of 3.3% or higher as a new floor guideline for dividends, replacing the previous reliance on payout ratio, and committed to progressive dividends with the prior-year per-share dividend as the minimum, effective from the fiscal year ending February 2028.
title_en: Notice on Change in Dividend Policy (Introduction of DOE Indicator and Progressive Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
CSP announced on October 9, 2026, that its Board of Directors has resolved to change its dividend policy effective from the fiscal year ending February 2028. The company will introduce Dividend on Equity (DOE) at a minimum of 3.3% as a new floor guideline for dividends, replacing its previous emphasis on consolidated payout ratio. Concurrently, the company will implement progressive dividends, with the prior fiscal year's per-share annual dividend serving as a floor.

The rationale for this change centers on balancing sustained investment for growth with shareholder returns to enhance long-term corporate value. CSP previously targeted a payout ratio of 33.3% for the fiscal year ending February 2030 under its medium-term business plan "Omoï 2030". The adoption of DOE as a new metric reflects management's intent to operate with greater awareness of capital efficiency while ensuring stable and continuous profit distribution to shareholders.

Under the revised policy, CSP will maintain a progressive dividend structure in which the per-share dividend cannot decrease from the prior year, thereby providing shareholders with predictable and sustainable capital returns. The new framework aims to strengthen shareholder distributions while preserving internal reserves necessary for business foundation strengthening and future operational expansion.
